name: Saga Tooru
source:
Hobbies: Guitar.
Likes: Music in general, [url=/c13501]Ririsu[/url].
Dislikes: Studying.

A second year student at Sumisora High School. While Tooru's a little bit of a luck-pusher, it was shown that his actions are not as great as his words. He is known in his school as a legendary useless person. Tooru plays the guitar. When it comes to music, he can listen to anything, from classical to death metal.
In "Next Relation", after getting a license, he purchases the motorcycle he always wanted.

In "Yubikiri no Kioku":
Childhood friend of [url=/c14771]Naoki[/url] and his friends. 
[spoiler]After failing the college entrance examination, Tooru goes to a prep school while working part-time. He still is hopelessly in love with Ririsu.[spoiler]

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_6:_T-wave]Wikipedia[/url] and translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/t-wave/chara08.html]the official site[/url] and [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off%E3%82%B7%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BA%E3%81%AE%E7%99%BB%E5%A0%B4%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9#.E3.83.A1.E3.83.A2.E3.83.AA.EF.BC.8D.E3.82.BA.E3.82.AA.E3.83.956_.E3.80.9CT-wave.E3.80.9C.E5.88.9D.E5.87.BA]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
